title: Where Are We in the Milky Way Galaxy? | Space Atlas
description: Earth isn't near the center of the galaxy, or anywhere special in it. Zoom out from the solar system to find our actual address in the Milky Way.
ogTitle: Where Are We in the Milky Way Galaxy?
ogDescription: About 26,000 light-years from the center, in a minor spiral arm — our actual cosmic address.
jsonldName: Where Are We in the Milky Way Galaxy?
jsonldDescription: A step-by-step zoom-out from the solar system to the Milky Way galaxy, locating Earth's position within the Orion Arm.
